action.description: status reports configured access channels; plan returns a safe acquisition plan; scan indexes local PDF/BibTeX files; resolve checks legal open-access locations for DOI inputs.

query.description: Research topic, title, author, or free-text query used to filter local files and build next actions.

dois.description: DOIs to resolve through legal open-access metadata providers.

libraryRoots.description: Optional container-visible local library roots to scan. Defaults to MATOS_LITERATURE_LIBRARY_ROOTS and common workspace literature folders.

maxResults.description: Maximum local file or DOI records to return. Default 50.

maxDepth.description: Maximum directory depth for local library scan. Default 5.
